content.text: Stripe and PayPal reject entire countries. Not individuals. Not businesses. Entire nations. If you're a digital creator in Nigeria, this isn't news. It's your daily reality. This isn't a policy quirk. It's structural exclusion. The solution isn't a workaround. It's sovereign commerce infrastructure. This post explains how to sell digital products without depending on any payment processor. Not Stripe. Not PayPal. Not even [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/get-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-crypto-payments-tanzanian-online-sellers-works-how|How Crypto]]-payments-tanzanian-online-sellers-working-today|crypto]] exchanges. Just you, your customers, and the open internet. We'll break down the architecture, the components, and the deployment process. By the end, you'll understand how to own your entire commerce stack — from hosting to payment verification to file delivery. No platform lock-in. No subscriptions. No country restrictions.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Plugins online

Sovereign commerce infrastructure is a complete digital commerce stack you own and control. It’s not a plugin or a service. It’s a combination of open tools deployed in a way that removes all single points of failure. Your store runs on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages — both free and globally distributed. Backend logic is handled by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Orders are stored in Supabase or Google Sheets. Files are delivered via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Payments are verified on-chain using NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies and charges a flat 0.5% fee. No buyer accounts required. No KYC. No platform dependence. This architecture is designed to bypass the exclusionary policies of payment processors. It’s not a hack. It’s base-layer infrastructure. Once deployed, you own it. COREMERCH delivers the stack. You control everything after that. This is how you stop renting and start owning.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

Here’s how the stack operates: Your store’s frontend is hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Both are free and serve static sites globally. Backend logic is handled by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. These execute code in response to user actions — like processing orders or verifying payments. Orders are stored in Supabase (a serverless PostgreSQL database) or Google Sheets (for simpler setups). File delivery is handled by Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Both offer reliable, low-cost storage. Payments are processed via NOWPayments. When a customer pays, NOWPayments verifies the transaction on-chain and fires a webhook. Your backend logic checks this webhook, updates the order status, and triggers file delivery. The entire process is automated. No manual intervention required. No platform in the middle. Just your stack, your rules, and your customers.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This is built for digital creators in countries where Stripe, PayPal, and other payment processors are unavailable or severely restricted. If you sell plugins, templates, software, or other digital products, this is for you. Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Ethiopia, Venezuela, Zimbabwe, Cameroon, Tanzania, Philippines — these are the regions where conventional payment processors fail. This stack is also for creators who want to own their infrastructure. No subscriptions. No platform lock-in. No country restrictions. It’s for people who understand that renting commerce infrastructure is a liability. Owning it is an asset. If you’re tired of being excluded, this is your alternative. It’s not a workaround. It’s a permanent solution built at the base layer.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure removes all platform dependence.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The stack consists of seven core components: 1. **Hosting**: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Free. Globally distributed. 2. **Backend Logic**: Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Handles order processing and payment verification. 3. **Order Storage**: Supabase or Google Sheets. Stores customer orders and payment details. 4. **File Delivery**: Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Delivers your digital products securely. 5. **Payment Verification**: NOWPayments. Supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. 0.5% fee. No KYC. 6. **Email Delivery**: Configured SPF/DKIM/DMARC for order confirmations. 7. **Documentation**: Complete blueprints and templates for deployment. Each component is free or low-cost. Together, they form a complete commerce stack. The Edge Commerce Stack from COREMERCH deploys this architecture in 48 hours, fully configured and tested. You get lifetime access. No subscriptions. No platform dependence.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Deploying your own sovereign commerce stack is straightforward. Start by choosing your components. For most creators, GitHub Pages + Google Apps Script + NOWPayments is a good starting point. If you need more scalability, go with Cloudflare Pages + Workers + Supabase. Next, configure NOWPayments to verify payments on-chain. Use BSC, Solana, or TRON for low transaction fees (under $0.10 per transaction). Set up your backend logic to check NOWPayments webhooks and trigger file delivery. Use Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to store your files. Test the entire process end-to-end. Once everything works, load your products and launch your store. The Edge Commerce Stack from COREMERCH handles all this for you. Deployed in 48 hours. 5 products loaded. SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured. End-to-end tested. $197. Lifetime access. No platform lock-in. No country restrictions. Just sovereign commerce infrastructure.

Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose your hosting: GitHub Pages (free) or Cloudflare Pages (free). 2. Set up backend logic: Google Apps Script (free) or Cloudflare Workers ($5/month). 3. Configure order storage: Google Sheets (free) or Supabase (free tier). 4. Prepare file delivery: Google Drive (free) or Cloudflare R2 ($5/month). 5. Integrate payment verification: NOWPayments (0.5% fee). 6. Test end-to-end: Place a test order and verify file delivery. 7. Load your products: Add descriptions, prices, and files. 8. Launch your store: Share the link with your customers. 9. Monitor transactions: Check NOWPayments dashboard for payment confirmations. 10. Scale as needed: Upgrade components as your sales grow.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m not a developer?
Yes. The Edge Commerce Stack from COREMERCH is deployed and configured for you. No coding required. You get lifetime access to a fully operational store.
What cryptocurrencies does NOWPayments support?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Binance Coin, and stablecoins like USDT. Recommended networks for low fees are BSC, Solana, and TRON.
How much does it cost to deploy this stack?
The Edge Commerce Stack from COREMERCH costs $197. This includes deployment, configuration, and 30-day support. After that, costs are minimal — mostly NOWPayments’ 0.5% fee per transaction.
Can I use this stack in Nigeria?

Yes. This stack is designed for digital creators in countries like Nigeria where Stripe and PayPal are unavailable. It bypasses payment processors entirely, using on-chain crypto verification instead.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?
NOWPayments is a verification service, not a custodian. If it’s unavailable, payments still process on-chain. Your backend logic can be configured to check blockchain directly as a fallback.
